agents.name: SA10SC-RLX
agents.sequence_source: Not printed as a plain one-letter string. PEPlife2's string carries three Aib residues and one Nle as hyphen-delimited three-letter codes; the 'SA10SC' serum-albumin-binding moiety the name refers to is not encoded.
agents.dose_route_quote: After intravenous administration of SA10SC-RLX at 1 mg/kg, the plasma clearance was considered as low at 0.43 mL/min/kg in rats
agents.pk_quote: After intravenous administration of SA10SC-RLX at 1 mg/kg, the plasma clearance was considered as low at 0.43 mL/min/kg in rats and 0.14 ml/min/kg in minipigs with a long apparent terminal half-life of 4 h in rats

concentration_time_figure.note: No concentration-time figure is captioned in the retrieved body; the parameters are given in the Results text.

notes: The single PEPlife2 value of 4 h is verified exactly against the Results text: 'a long apparent terminal half-life of 4 h in rats' after 1 mg/kg intravenous, with plasma clearance of 0.43 mL/min/kg. PEPlife2 labels it '(Terminal Half Life)', matching. SEQUENCE ENCODING: the stored string contains three Aib residues and one Nle as hyphen-delimited three-letter codes, which previously expanded into nine spurious standard residues under one-letter cleaning; clean_sequence now collapses each to a single X. The albumin-binding SA10SC moiety that the compound is named for, and to which the low clearance is attributed, is not encoded at all. No group size or dispersion is reported for the rat value.
